hypothesis: Clause-learning SAT with cardinality encodings will resolve the finite radius-3 coordinated-repair cover more effectively than CP-SAT or capped Python DFS and may expose a validator-accepted scope-111 DTS.
rationale: The exhaustive radius-3 neighborhood contains 48,100 valid row masks; the prior DFS reached depth 5 at its node cap and candidate-level CP-SAT returned UNKNOWN. A compact Boolean exact-cover formula with exactly-one row constraints and at-most-one difference constraints is suitable for clause learning and tests propagation independently of CP-SAT.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether the unresolved local cover is a propagation weakness of the previous solvers or remains hard under a clause-learning SAT architecture.
method: Reuse the exact radius-3 row pools without changing their generation. Encode one Boolean per candidate, exactly one candidate per baseline row, and at most one selected candidate per difference using PySAT sequential-counter cardinality encodings and Glucose4. Run under WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04 Python 3.14 with python-sat 1.9.dev15, a 120-second wall timeout, and independently validate any selected rows.
metric: SAT status, candidate/Boolean/clause counts, elapsed time, selected rows, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A SAT assignment accepted by the independent integer validator is exactly a true-objective scope<=111 witness; UNSAT would establish only that the explicitly enumerated radius-3 neighborhood has no cover, while UNKNOWN is solver evidence only.

configuration.candidate_generation: same exhaustive 7^5 perturbations and mask deduplication as dts-neighborhood-exact-001
configuration.encoding: sequential-counter exactly-one row and at-most-one difference

kill_condition: Stop after a validator-valid SAT assignment, UNSAT, or 120 seconds; do not expand the candidate neighborhood during this experiment.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if SAT and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new information from SAT status or a validator-valid witness

interpretation: Glucose4 did not return a status or output artifact within the 120-second wall budget and was interrupted. This is runtime evidence only; it establishes neither satisfiability nor infeasibility of the radius-3 neighborhood.
what_was_learned: The SAT encoding is not a practical short-budget route in its current sequential-counter form. The radius-3 neighborhood remains unresolved, but another solver/encoding on the same neighborhood is not justified without a materially new structural reason.
recommended_next_action: If SAT, freeze and adversarially verify the rows; if UNSAT, record the bounded neighborhood exclusion; if UNKNOWN, close the radius-3 family and require a wider structural representation.
repetition_justification: This is a materially different solver architecture and clause encoding from both direct CP-SAT and the prior Python DFS, while reusing the same exhaustively enumerated finite candidate set to isolate propagation effects.
